title.en: A court account of the Torghut arrival
title.zh: 宫廷笔下的土尔扈特东迁

alt.en: Calligraphy on an album opening names the Torghut khan Ubashi; red collection seals overlap the text.
alt.zh: 册页书法题及土尔扈特汗渥巴锡，红色鉴藏印叠于文字间。

caption.en: Qian Chenqun’s transcription opens with Qianlong’s 1771 text on Ubashi and the Torghut migration. The copying itself is not separately dated.
caption.zh: 钱陈群书册开篇为乾隆1771年关于渥巴锡及土尔扈特东迁的文字，抄写时间未另行注明。

interpretation.en: The opening names the migrating community and reports its arrival at Ili. Its language of submission reveals how the Qing court framed the movement, rather than giving the migrants’ own account.
interpretation.zh: 开篇点明迁徙群体并记其抵达伊犁；“归顺”的措辞显示清廷如何解释此事，并非迁徙者自身的叙述。

items.creator: Qian Chenqun; text by the Qianlong emperor
items.date: Qing dynasty; transcribes an imperial text of 1771
items.institution: National Palace Museum, Taipei; 故書000787N000000000

title.en: The white eagle presented by a Torghut noble
title.zh: 土尔扈特贵族进献的白鹰

alt.en: A white eagle spreads one wing on a padded perch with lion-shaped feet; an imperial poem occupies the upper right.
alt.zh: 白鹰在软垫鹰架上展开一翼，鹰架有狮形足；右上方为御制诗。

caption.en: Ignaz Sichelbarth painted the white eagle presented by the Torghut noble Shilakouken. Yu Minzhong’s inscription dates to 1773, the first ten days of the eighth lunar month.
caption.zh: 艾启蒙绘土尔扈特贝子锡喇扣肯所进白鹰；于敏中题记纪年1773年农历八月上旬。

interpretation.en: The named gift makes the court relationships following the Torghut migration tangible. The inscription falls two years after the 1771 arrival; the image concerns a later tribute encounter, not the journey itself.
interpretation.zh: 具名贡物使土尔扈特迁徙之后的宫廷关系可见；题记在1771年抵达的两年之后，图画呈现后续进贡交往，而不是迁徙途中。

items.creator: Ignaz Sichelbarth (Ai Qimeng); inscription by Yu Minzhong
items.date: Qing dynasty; inscription dated 1773, eighth lunar month, first ten days
items.institution: National Palace Museum, Taipei; 故畫003085N000000000

title.en: A Chenghua cup combining blue and coloured enamels
title.zh: 青花与彩料相合的成化斗彩杯

alt.en: A small white porcelain cup carries blue outlines and coloured details of a scholar, attendant and bamboo.
alt.zh: 小型白瓷杯以青花轮廓与彩色细节描绘文士、侍童及竹丛。

caption.en: Doucai cup, Chenghua reign, 1465–1487. Underglaze blue outlines are combined with red, yellow and green overglaze enamels.
caption.zh: 成化时期（1465—1487年）斗彩杯，以釉下青花勾线，配合釉上红、黄、绿彩。

interpretation.en: Blue outlines and coloured enamel coordinate decoration below and above the glaze. Figures and plants bring literary taste into a small vessel used in Ming material life.
interpretation.zh: 青花线条与彩绘协调釉下、釉上的装饰，人物与花木把文人趣味带入明代日用小器。

alt.en: Pines, curling rocks and mist lead upward to high peaks; tiny paths, buildings and streams animate the mountains.
alt.zh: 松树、卷曲山石与云雾向高峰延伸，细小山径、楼阁与溪流点染山间。

caption.en: Early Spring, signed and dated 1072 by Guo Xi. The poem at upper right was added by Qianlong in 1759.
caption.zh: 郭熙款署1072年的《早春图》；右上方御题诗为乾隆1759年所加。

interpretation.en: Rock masses rise through bands of mist, with paths, trees and buildings leading the eye between near and distant views. Guo Xi’s court landscape creates an imagined world that people could inhabit.
interpretation.zh: 山石穿过层层烟岚，路径、树木和建筑引导视线往来于近景与远景。郭熙的宫廷山水营造出可居游的想象世界。

title.en: Fan Kuan’s towering mountains and minute travelers
title.zh: 范宽笔下的巨峰与微小行旅

alt.en: A massive central cliff rises above a misty valley, wooded slopes and a small pack-animal train.
alt.zh: 巨大主峰立于云谷、林坡与细小驮队之上。

caption.en: Fan Kuan’s Travelers Among Mountains and Streams, Northern Song. The work is undated; Dong Qichang’s title above the painting is a later addition.
caption.zh: 北宋范宽《谿山行旅图》，本画未纪年；画上董其昌题签为后加。

interpretation.en: Tiny travellers move beneath a towering rock face. Compare this dramatic change in scale with Guo Xi’s shifting viewpoints; the museum distinguishes Fan Kuan’s life away from official service from Guo’s court career.
interpretation.zh: 微小行旅从巨岩之下经过。可将强烈的尺度反差同郭熙不断转换的视点对照；馆方区分范宽未仕的生涯与郭熙的宫廷经历。

title.en: Ni Zan’s landscape for a departing friend
title.zh: 倪瓒为送友而作的江岸山水

alt.en: An empty pavilion and trees occupy the near shore, across broad water from layered mountains; several inscriptions stand above.
alt.zh: 近岸有空亭与树木，隔着宽阔水面是重叠山峰，上方列有多段题记。

caption.en: Mountains Viewed from a Riverbank, 1363, second lunar month, day 17. The museum identifies it as a farewell gift; the recipient’s name was later altered and remains uncertain.
caption.zh: 《江岸望山图》，1363年农历二月十七日。馆方指出此为赠行之作，但受赠人姓名后经改动，身份未定。

interpretation.en: An empty pavilion, broad water and distant hills separate the near and far banks. The inscription turns this private landscape into a social gift, with its original recipient’s identity still uncertain.
interpretation.zh: 空亭、宽阔水面与远山隔开近岸和彼岸，题诗则使私人山水成为赠答之礼；原受赠者身份仍未确定。

items.institution: National Palace Museum, Taipei; 故畫000292N000000000

title.en: The standardization edict on a Qin measure
title.zh: 秦量上的统一度量衡诏书

alt.en: A rubbing records a handled oval measure and its inscription, with later collector writing and seals.
alt.zh: 拓片记录带柄椭圆量器及铭文，旁有后世藏家题记与印章。

caption.en: Undated paper rubbing of a Qin measure bearing the forty-character standardization edict of 221 BCE. The rubbing itself is not dated to the Qin dynasty.
caption.zh: 未纪年纸本秦量拓片，所拓为公元前221年四十字统一度量衡诏书；拓片本身并非据此定为秦代。

interpretation.en: The inscription explicitly orders inconsistent measures to be unified. It directly documents the Qin entry’s standardization policy, while the vessel outline shows the practical measuring object carrying that order.
interpretation.zh: 铭文明确要求度量不一者统一，直接对应秦条目的标准化政策；器形拓影显示承载诏令的实际量器。

items.creator: Unidentified rubbing maker; Qin imperial inscription
items.date: Rubbing undated; reproduces an edict of 221 BCE
items.institution: National Palace Museum, Taipei; 贈拓000355N000000000

title.en: Wen Zhengming copies the Drunken Pavilion essay

alt.en: Fine regular-script columns reproduce the essay beside a dated signature and red seals.
alt.zh: 小楷纵行抄录文章，旁有纪年署款与朱印。

caption.en: Wen Zhengming’s copy dated 1551, seventh lunar month, day 24, of Ouyang Xiu’s Drunken Pavilion essay. It is a later copy, not the 1046 original.
caption.zh: 文徵明1551年农历七月二十四日书欧阳修《醉翁亭记》，为后世抄本，而非1046年原稿。

interpretation.en: The named text is the literary work central to the Chuzhou entry. A Ming calligrapher’s careful transcription shows its continuing readership centuries after Ouyang’s local service.
interpretation.zh: 此篇正是滁州条目的核心文学作品；明代书家精心抄写，展示欧阳修任职数百年后的持续阅读与传播。

title.en: A court commemoration of the Altishahr campaign
title.zh: 宫廷纪念平定回部的碑文

alt.en: The opening of a calligraphic scroll announces an imperial inscription commemorating completion of the campaign.
alt.zh: 书法卷开篇题明御制平定回部告成碑文。

caption.en: The opening of Guanbao’s undated copy of Qianlong’s inscription commemorating the conquest of Altishahr.
caption.zh: 观保未纪年书乾隆《平定回部告成太学碑文》的开篇。

interpretation.en: Large regular characters and imperial seals frame a celebration of Qing victory. The emperor’s political language records official commemoration from the conquering court’s perspective.
interpretation.zh: 端整大字与御玺包围着清军报捷文字。皇帝的政治语言记录征服一方的宫廷纪功。

context.en: The named text is the literary work central to the Chuzhou entry. A Ming calligrapher’s careful transcription shows its continuing readership centuries after Ouyang’s local service.
context.zh: 此篇正是滁州条目的核心文学作品；明代书家精心抄写，展示欧阳修任职数百年后的持续阅读与传播。

context.en: Large regular characters and imperial seals frame a celebration of Qing victory. The emperor’s political language records official commemoration from the conquering court’s perspective.
context.zh: 端整大字与御玺包围着清军报捷文字。皇帝的政治语言记录征服一方的宫廷纪功。
